title: hydrophyllum capitatum var. thompsonii
intro: Hydrophyllum capitatum var. thompsonii, commonly known as Western or Western waterleaf, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Hydrophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to aid in digestion, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve respiratory issues and soothe digestive discomfort. The therapeutic actions of Western waterleaf are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscle, reduce inflammation, and promote the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Hydrophyllum capitatum var. thompsonii include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
